summary: Add a count-verified Judge.me review sync, explicit population views, body-hash syndication analysis, private-key header auth, and fail-closed mutation gates on CLI and MCP surfaces.
reason: Judge.me silently repeats page 100 after 10,000 rows, returns non-storefront reviews in ordinary listings, and syndicates identical bodies across products. Its private token must be sent in X-Api-Token rather than a URL or OAuth bearer header. These behaviors are API-specific and therefore belong in the printed CLI rather than the Printing Press generator.
validated_outcome: Unit tests prove repeated-page detection, count-mismatch refusal, normalized body hashing, atomic SQLite replacement, private-token header placement, CLI mutation gating, MCP mutation gating, population filtering, and the curated publication fallback when published is absent. Live verification confirmed that published is present and agrees with curated on the sampled account response, then matched the full corpus and published counts after the fallback was added.
